description.text:
The seventh POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments from March to September 2008.

Every card in the packs is non-holo. Holo copies came later in shop products: Latias, Latios and Mothim in Legends Awakened blisters (August 2008), Ampharos and Kirlia in a Collector's Box (December 2008), and Gallade in a blister pack of its own (March 2009).

tell.text: No foil anywhere on the card.
Cosmos foil whose dots and circles are blocky, as if made of pixels, not smooth.

description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy from the Collector's Box sold at stores such as Toys "R" Us and Kmart in December 2008, which held it and the same foil Kirlia with four booster packs and a Theme Deck. It isn't found in POP Series 7 packs, which held only non-holo copies of the set's rares.
